name: Iconography
title: Iconography
summary: Two icon sets: filled ministry icons for features and illustrations, and a thin line set for interface controls, plus the direction rule for carets and arrows.
whenToUse: **Ministry icons** (`assets/icons/*.svg`, filled, 24dp Material-style): feature lists, stat tiles, "how it works" steps, partner and outreach content. Examples: bible, radio, satellite, translate, folded-hands, church, handshake, qr-code.
**UI line icons** (inline SVG): buttons, fields, navigation, app bars, list rows, toasts. Search, close, menu, chevrons, arrows, play, share, download, check.
whenNotToUse: Do not mix the two sets inside one control or one row of features.

anatomy.description: Ministry icon as an image (renders black; invert on dark): UI line icon, inline:

props.name: set
props.description: Which set to list: the thin UI line icons or the filled ministry icons.

props.name: size
props.description: Icon size in px. UI: 16, 20 or 24. Ministry: 24, 32 or 48.

props.name: showNames
props.description: Show the icon name under each icon.

variantNotes: **Sizes:** UI icons 16 (inline with small text), 20 (buttons, fields, nav), 24 (app bars, tab bars). Ministry icons 24, 32, 48.
**Colour:** UI icons inherit `currentColor`. Ministry icons are black on light and inverted on dark. Inside a tinted tile, place the icon on `--blue-tint` with the tile at `--radius-md`.
**Interactive:** an icon-only control is an IconButton: 44px tap target, visible focus ring.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Down caret ⌄ means it **opens or expands here** (menus, selects, accordions, sub-navigation).
Diagonal arrow ↗ means it **goes to another page** or site.
Right chevron › means it **drills into a screen inside an app** (list rows, settings).
A plain right arrow → is for a primary "continue" action only.
UI line icons: 24 viewBox, `stroke="currentColor"`, stroke-width 1.8 (1.6–2.2), round caps and joins, no fill.
Never colour icons with status colours unless the icon IS the status (alert, toast, field error).
Notification dots and counts on icons are Horizon Blue (`.count`, `--horizon-blue`), never red.
